description: Specializing in modernizing legacy architectures and building offline-first enterprise solutions.

projects.name: Farm Management Suite (FMS)
projects.description: An offline-first PWA ecosystem managing the entire agricultural lifecycle from harvest to packhouse logistics.
projects.challenge: Connectivity in remote farmlands is unstable. The client needed zero data loss during harvest logging, even when devices were offline for hours.
highlights: Harvest Module: Architected the field operations tool using Vue 3 and IndexedDB. Implemented an 'Outbox' pattern to queue requests during connectivity loss, ensuring 100% data integrity upon sync.
Packing Module: Streamlined logistics from receival to dispatch. Optimized pallet workflows and integrated real-time QA reporting.
Central Admin (Migration): Spearheaded the complete migration of the legacy admin dashboard from Vue 2 to Vue 3 (Composition API), reducing bundle size and improving load times by 50%.

projects.name: Recruitment Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive automated hiring platform replacing manual Excel-based tracking.
projects.challenge: The HR team was spending 15+ hours weekly manually parsing emails and organizing resume files.
highlights: Engineered Azure Functions to automatically trigger on email receipt, parsing attachments and populating the database, reducing manual HR effort by 80%.
Built a Resume Parsing module that categorizes candidates based on skill keywords automatically.
